risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/content/index.ts, content-admin.module.ts, apps/api/src/app.module.ts): a structural change with no change in behaviour (ledger #1741, follow-up of B2-11d / B1-34a). content/index.ts now exports ContentAdminOptions, ConfigItemAdmin / KillSwitchAdmin with their check types, and configRegistry. ContentAdminModule.forAdmin takes configItemChecks / killSwitchChecks and passes them to the two use cases. The defaults keep the old behaviour: no save checks, and the switch-on stays refused; with no database no switch checks are built, as the old wrapper did. app.module drops the three imports of content internals, the two TODOs and the wrapper that rebuilt forAdmin's providers. It passes the same payout checks through the options: save = AUTO_PAYOUT_SAVE_KEYS with autoPayoutWriteRefusals, and autoPayoutEnable = readAutoPayoutEnableCheck with content's reader per handle and one createDefaultReconPassedDays. The existing payout/auto-config, save-wiring, content/config-items and kill-switch tests pass unchanged. Rule tests (admin-check-options, 7) by a fresh independent Claude (approvals #36), red PASS on the spec commit. Implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run. verify:fast in the test-machine container exit 0. Full verify on the test machine (verify/1): exit 124 at the 3600 s limit with no failing case before it; save-wiring.int 12/12, content config-items / kill-switches integration suites and admin-check-options passed; recorded per D10-319, CI verify-int is the check.
